title: Custom Disc Maestro
description: A mod that introduces a realistic music disc manufacturing pipeline, letting players compose note-block music, chemically process master discs, press custom records with vinyl degradation mechanics.
body:
A mod that turns making music discs into a hands-on manufacturing pipeline — the way real vinyl is made (almost). Compose a tune in the piano-roll sequencer (or import a `.nbs` file), cut it to a **master disc**, grow a **galvanic matrix** in a poisonous kupfernickel bath, **press** dyed records with album-cover sleeves — and mind the groove wear: discs degrade as they play. All audio uses Minecraft's own note-block sounds; multiplayer-safe and positional.

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1590102/description_f3e588b0-4248-4270-ba6e-ab7b2bdc9232.png)
